## Handover notes

- `a04-ux-designer--a11y-sheet`: Fill `artifacts` (sheet, digest), `completed` (areas audited), `remaining` and `open_questions` (areas not audited), `verification` (`verified` only when all five areas were audited and the verdict is `pass`). `to_agent` A06 for implementation, A08 for tests; the sheet travels as this handover's artifact, since neither accepts `a11y.requirements` as a routed message type.
- `a04-ux-designer--a11y-triage`: Fill `completed` (violations classified), `remaining` (code-defect requests), `decisions` (class and evidence per violation), `open_questions`, `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A01 for code defects; to A06 or A08 for the revised spec.
- `a04-ux-designer--focus-visible`: Fill `completed` (flows covered), `decisions` (focus order rationale, ring token chosen), `open_questions` (unidentified surfaces), `verification` (ratios as `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A06 (it implements the order) or A08 (keyboard tests) as the task names.
- `a04-ux-designer--lofi-fallback`: Fill `constraints` (spec is lofi or PROVISIONAL and must be re-reviewed), `remaining` (high-fidelity frames, brand review), `decisions` (default theme used), `verification` (`status` partial, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A06 or A08 as the task names; they must read `constraints` before relying on the spec.
- `a04-ux-designer--motion-review`: Fill `completed` (animations reviewed), `decisions` (bound used and why, variants added), `constraints` (A06 must honour the reduced-motion variant), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A06 when variants change its work, else the downstream agent the task names.
- `a04-ux-designer--new-component`: Fill `goal`, `completed` (checks run), `blockers` (the L3 approval), `decisions` (why no existing component fit), `artifacts` (spec path, digest, `producer` A04), `verification` (`status` partial until approved, `confidence`, `checks`). Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` A01, who owns the approval request; `shared_escalate`'s `result_patch` is the BLOCKED task result.
- `a04-ux-designer--palette-contrast`: Fill `completed` (pairs measured), `decisions` (each recolour with its ratio before and after), `blockers` (the brand conflict), `open_questions` (unmeasured pairs), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A01 when blocked, else to the downstream agent the task names (A06).
- `a04-ux-designer--responsive-targets`: Fill `completed` (breakpoints checked), `decisions` (size and spacing changes), `remaining` (breakpoints skipped), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks` = counts per breakpoint). `shared_handover_write` to A06 when sizes change its layout, to A08 for responsive test baselines.
- `a04-ux-designer--screen-spec`: Fill `goal`, `completed` (screens specified), `artifacts` (kind `ux.spec`, spec path, digest, `producer` A04), `decisions` (components reused and why), `open_questions` (unknown criteria), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks` = the three check results). `shared_handover_write` to A06 (implementation) or A08 (UI test baseline) as the task names.
- `a04-ux-designer--token-lint`: Fill `goal` (lint of the named token file), `completed` (checks run), `remaining` (fixes owed), `decisions` (depth, roots, base unit chosen and why), `verification` (`verified` only if every check ran; confidence from the share of checks that ran). Call `shared_handover_write` with `to_agent` set to the downstream agent the task names (A06 when the tokens are next consumed), else A01.
- `a04-ux-designer--token-release`: Fill `decisions` (bump with its cause), `artifacts` (released file, digest from `shared_artifact_digest`, `producer` A04), `blockers` (L3 approval), `constraints` (alias removal one release later), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A06 when released, A01 when blocked.
- `a04-ux-designer--usability-redesign`: Fill `decisions` (chosen option with rationale), `open_questions` (stakeholder objections requested), `blockers` (unresolved conflict), `remaining` (findings still open), `verification` (`status`, `confidence`, `checks`). `shared_handover_write` to A06 once the revised spec is ready, to A01 when escalated or awaiting objections.
